items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Colours for light and dark mode with the names and values of the web theme, plus radii, type sizes, font families, shadows and motion springs. useTheme() follows the device; ThemeProvider forces a scheme; withAlpha() is the native take on opacity modifiers.

items.name: haptics
items.title: Haptics
items.description: haptic("selection" | "light" | "success" …): a fire-and-forget vibration through expo-haptics that never throws and does nothing on the web, plus setHapticsEnabled() for an app-wide setting.
items.docs: Install the native module for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install expo-haptics

items.name: story-export
items.title: Story Export
items.description: Stories for Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok from views: captureStory() turns a view into a 1080 × 1920 PNG on any screen density, shareStory() opens the share sheet with it and puts a link on the clipboard, and useStoryUnit() lays templates out in the image's pixels, with the safe area the apps draw over. The same names as the web story-export item.
items.docs: Install the native modules for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install react-native-view-shot expo-sharing expo-clipboard. For Save Image in the iOS share sheet, add NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription under ios.infoPlist in app.json.
